sections.heading: Intramural Basketball Interest Meeting
sections.markdown:
Wednesday, December 9 | 11:30 AM - 12:30 PM

Barber Physical Activity Center, Health Promotions Classroom

League information will be discussed -- rules, structure, start date, schedule, etc.

Basketball league is open to all active-duty, their dependents (18+) and DoD civilians aboard MCBQ.

For more information call, 703.432.1475
